_note: pipeline-lead-rotation. An agent profile gets a cap on the leads rotation gives it per 30 days and a switch to pause its share; a lead records why rotation gave it to someone and when. LeadRotationService writes assignmentReason and assignedAt, never a form: both are hidden in forms and carry x-openregister.serverSet. Neither is readOnly, because OpenRegister refuses a changed readOnly value on every update and the rotation writes them on a lead that already exists. No property changes type and none becomes required.

leadCapPer30Days.title: Lead cap per 30 days
leadCapPer30Days.description: The most leads automatic assignment gives this colleague in 30 days. Empty means no cap.

pauseLeadAssignment.title: Pause lead assignment
pauseLeadAssignment.description: While on, automatic assignment gives this colleague no new leads.

assignmentReason.title: Why assigned
assignmentReason.description: Why automatic assignment gave this lead to this colleague, or why it found nobody.

assignedAt.title: Assigned on
assignedAt.description: When automatic assignment gave this lead to its colleague.
